kills.property: If the provided caller address is not equal to c.Owner(), then calling c.withdraw must revert.
kills.change_summary: Invert the require so it requires caller is NOT Owner, preventing Owner from calling withdraw but allowing others to trigger transfer to Owner.

kills.property: When Command is called by the Owner it must not revert (i.e., calls from Owner always succeed).
kills.change_summary: Insert a revert after the require to block the call entirely, so Command no longer forwards execution to the target and its observable effects differ.

kills.property: When InvMutTest calls c.Command as the Owner of c, the Command call itself must not revert (didRevert == false).
kills.change_summary: Change the call to capture and require success, reverting on failure; this makes failed target calls revert the whole Command invocation, altering observable behavior.
